title: THE DEAD ON THE MAP: ZOOM IN AND THEY ARE THERE, GRAVES ONLY WHERE PEOPLE LIVE
said: we don't see enough corpses even throughout the world... billions of people have died
why: Zoom the map in close and the dead lie where nobody is left to bury them: the pit at the landfill and the stadiums, cars on the freeway, tarps and carts in the washes and the yards, and only graves near a town. On the map in the RUN tab, pinched in close (left with them off, right with them on).

before_after.before: main: COOK DEAD's thirteen dead (11/3) were on no page; the map showed no dead at any zoom
before_after.after: 711 dead on the demo's valley on 18 kinds of ground, up close only (from a block 96 px), graves only within 2 blocks of a town or a place, never on ground he has not seen or on a tower's face
